Use that pose, then nearest legal adjacent same-plane placement with stable lexicographic tie-breaking. No interior fit means pending return, no crushing, remote relocation or fresh turn. Actual transport prohibitions block this return; absence from another source's cell is not unilaterally canceled by this trait. On lawful release from that source, this return obligation resumes if its Seal is still active. HP, Wounds, roots, concentration, original deadlines, recharge and resources never reset. Real death does not respawn the creature. Destroying/deactivating the actual Seal ends this trait's pending return only. New neutral destructible Seal fixture: Small real object, AC15/20HP, no immunities, reachable normal object attacks; an actual authorized mechanism may deactivate it with Action/Engineering DC15. This is a counterplay fixture completion, not an assertion of a Gate's cosmological origin or a guaranteed passage/reward.

144.selectedProcedure: NEW AA02. Record one actual encounter anchor and its position/state. Until that same anchor is activated or destroyed, each otherwise lawful involuntary teleport or forced-movement event affecting this creature rolls one private d6:1–3 prevents that displacement only;4–6 uses the ordinary effect unchanged. A single source movement vector rolls once, not per foot, body or callback. Separate accompanying damage/conditions remain independently eligible. This is unreliable displacement, not autoimmunity and not proof that the creature is absent. An already prohibited transport rolls nothing. Actual voluntary travel is not gained or barred. Once the anchor is activated/destroyed, remove the interference for the encounter without healing/resetting the creature. New neutral anchor fixture is a real Small AC15/15HP object; known accessible activation uses one Action and Arcana or Engineering DC15. Exact tools/language/safe access remain required by the chosen method. The object location is not disclosed by a failed relocation; it must be found through real perception/research.
